estimand_contract.population: 60 prospectively authored complete relation statements across operational, scientific, safety and coordination domains: 20 nonempty temporal overlaps, 20 whole-interval positive states and 20 contrasts

aggregation.rule: equal item mean within each of three equally sized marker strata per tokenizer (equivalently their equal-stratum pooled mean), then maximum tokenizer mean; all three form strata are reported

manifest.study_scope: Current token-cost replication only. Fictional relation statements, not observations of events, reader comprehension, adoption, enforcement or future tokenizer performance.
manifest.selection: One authored set of 20 fresh statements per form, preserving the three source renderers, frozen before tokenization. Complete pairs and both individual arms differ from source and existing replica. No token-guided selection, repeats or dropped adverse outcomes.
manifest.prediction_before_count: The fixed contrast wrapper may cost more than whereas. Exact per-form numerical reproduction is uncertain; one token over 20 overlap cases can exceed the original tolerance. File the first finite valid result regardless of agreement.

freshness_audit.boundary: Fresh instances of fixed renderers; not a random natural-language sample.

sample_size_exception.rationale: Preserve the source 60-pair contract, 20 fresh cases in each of three equally weighted strata. A 64-item power-of-two design would change the exact source population weighting; the documented inherited replication exception preserves it.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
